name: Integra Switchgear Limited
about: Integra Switchgear Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical switches and other electrical products in India. It offers switchgear products, including relays, as well as miniature circuit breakers and isolators. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Vadodara, India. Integra Switchgear Limited operates as a subsidiary of Northvale Capital Partners Private Limited.
